# AgenticConsensus

> An early, local-first research prototype for a shared, versioned project state in human–AI coding collaboration.

AgenticConsensus connects intent, code, version-bound requirements and evidence,
and authorized human decisions. It reviews Git revisions and read-only GitHub
pull-request snapshots. Optional model advice has no decision authority.
Source analysis currently focuses on Python imports; automated realization is
bounded to Python import substitution. A recorded decision does not merge a PR.
Examples are synthetic; no general security or developer-outcome claims are made.

- [Public source](https://github.com/GeminiLight/AgenticConsensus)
- [Official website](https://tianfuwang.tech/AgenticConsensus/)

- [Security boundary](https://github.com/GeminiLight/AgenticConsensus/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
